claim_boundary: This is a source-linked inventory audit, not a dataset acquisition or benchmark run. The canonical rows retain explicit train/eval policy; every supplemental row remains catalog_only. No task prompts, screenshots, credentials, emulator/VM images, MCP service state, verifier traces, or live side effects are included. A train-policy row still requires a separate license-reviewed, revision/hash-bound acquisition receipt and source-specific adapter.
